fmea_modes.cause: Transport, syntax checks, labels and real semantic correctness are conflated.
fmea_modes.effect: False quality evidence can select models that produce incorrect or unsafe artifacts.
fmea_modes.controls: Independent oracles, wrong-answer controls, tool discovery, per-domain outcomes, exact hashes and stage labels.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Report valid oracle coverage and real tool availability without granting quality or release authority

ucas.context: A necessary hazard repair is never selected.
ucas.constraint: Check safety class and inherited prerequisite urgency before score.

ucas.context: A high score is mistaken for release authorization.
ucas.constraint: Authorization and effect constraints precede ranking.

ucas.context: Selection relies on a stale candidate or unfinished dependency.
ucas.constraint: Re-observe and reject affected stale/blocked selection.

ucas.context: An old worker keeps acting beyond its lease or budget.
ucas.constraint: Recheck current owner, fencing, expiry and budget before effects.

residuals: Tool presence is not candidate execution evidence.
Tiny fixtures cannot establish broad language or safety competence.
Whole-system admission is outside this review.
decision.budget: No network/model calls, installs or implementation/fixture builds; read-only local tool version/help probes and mandatory isolated administrative risk checker only; no agents spawned.
decision.reviewer: Independent Codex /root/hooks, parent and capabilities own integration and case implementation.
decision.rollback: Correct only owned task artifacts; preserve all implementation and runtime state.
acceptance: Review proposed case/validator semantics and report stage-qualified defects
Find actual realized tool locators and source-backed invocation commands without implementation builds
Give falsifiers for Gleam, OCaml, Mojo, Lean, Quint, STM, Bayesian, Rete-UL, STPA and FMEA
Separate API health, format, executable correctness, bounded formal results and quality
Inspect exact task scope, immutable body preparation, fixed ledger, replay, receipt-loss and credential handling; distinguish source from executed evidence
Deliver timestamped native-tool and review receipt with limits
decision.falsifier: A constant/no-op/wrong implementation, invalid proof, unsound temporal model or missing tool receives a quality pass; or an unfenced/unbound/replayed paid request reaches POST without retained canonical liability.
decision.forecast: Independent controls and per-domain outcomes prevent transport success or harness defects from inflating model quality.
assumptions: Parent owns paid evaluation and runtime integration; this task has no paid, build, service, VCS or source mutation authority.
Case catalog may still be staged; review reports exact source state.
counterevidence: A functioning API or compiler executable is not evidence of model competence.
Existing bounded capability tests do not rank coding or decision quality.
A per-database reservation or cooperative process lock does not establish account-wide billing or crash-safe global single-flight authority.
alternatives: Inspect proposed cases and identify independent quality oracles
Report toolkit availability separately until proposed cases exist
decision.summary: Review staged evaluation methodology, realized native toolchains and the paid guard's authority, body and budget boundaries without implementation builds or model calls

snapshot.reference: Fresh exact scoped source snapshot; runtime observed separately.

scope: Independent read-only evaluation/toolchain and paid-guard boundary review; only own review artifacts; no model calls or runtime/source/VCS effects
